authorMeta.name: bxrbie__wxrld
text:
I want the girls to bring ORIGINALITY back ! 😍 inspiration is cute, but duplication not- so- much 🫠

I want to start a new fun series right here in Bxrbie Wxrld where I show you how to style popular and trendy pieces in a less predictable way! Absolutely nothing is wrong with following trends and inspiration, but the girls are straight up wearing the exact same outfits! 💆🏽‍♀️

Now yall look good, so if you don’t agree keep scrolling 🥰 but for those who shop on @Fashion Nova @sheinofficial @Missguided @AKIRA @Von Dutch @SUMWON & many other popular brands, I want to show you tips to style those trendy pieces in a unique way 🎀 

This outfit may not be for YOU, but take these same tips & apply it to your own wardrobe 🤏🏼

Comment “🎀” if you want more of this series 👏🏼

If you’re new here, Welcome to Bxrbie Wxrld where fashion is not a hobby— it’s a lifestyle 💘

#bxrbiemakesfashionfunagain #fyp #fashiontiktok #fashionseries #blackgirloutfitideas

FASHION EXPOSURE THERAPY: a concept I thought of to easily explain how to find your personal style, learning to love the awkwardness, and the key to becoming the real world you, not the Pinterest version of you! 🧠

It’s taken me years to find my style that feels personal and perfectly curated to my body, personality and mind! I’m constantly asked the question and I always catch myself running on long tangents trying to explain it. So one day, I decided to conceptually create a concept that answers all your questions in full, I hope this helps! 💋💋💋💋💋
